# Practical Solutions

> Tenant app Practical Solutions (ultrastable.org): evidence-based solutions to global problems.

## Live

- [Practical Solutions](https://ultrastable.org/): the running system
- [Health report](https://ultrastable.org/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://ultrastable.org/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://ultrastable.org/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)

## Code

- [worker/src/index.js](worker/src/index.js): the Worker's routes
